<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Download onboarding document file by ID</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"get"} path={"/v1/users/onboardings/{onboarding_id}/documents/{id}"}></MethodEndpoint>



Initiate the download of an onboarding document file by providing its ID. If you haven't uploaded a file yet, use the appropriate endpoint to do so.
